premises.text: LightShot is a sensor-based mobile platform for fully interactive gaming anywhere
premises.evidence_span: sensor based mobile gaming platform that allows completely interactive gaming anywhere in the world

premises.text: Hardware loop: lighter IR beam to puck, phone confirms mission and next timer
premises.evidence_span: lighter. It shoots an infrared beam to the light puck. which immediately registers here and if you bring up the phone you can see that the mission has been completed and the timer is already ticking down

premises.text: Cloud-based open-source software and hardware let players build games and peripherals
premises.evidence_span: with the platform both being open source software and open source hardware. you're able to develop your own games and your own peripherals

premises.text: Multi-sensor programmable lighter supports many genres; kits enable custom peripherals
premises.evidence_span: array of sensors, a Bluetooth, IR, accelerometers, and others that you can program for whatever type of game you want

premises.text: Gameplay automates the game master with customizable rule sets across connected IoT devices
premises.evidence_span: no longer do you need a game master for each of these interactive-type games. Now all of it's automated, and you have the ability to customize your own game with own rule sets

premises.text: HUD shows live health, stats, and teammate locations
premises.evidence_span: Players can see what other location of their teammates, they can see their health stats, depending on what game they're playing

premises.text: Revenue from first-party apps/peripherals plus third-party developer hosting
premises.evidence_span: own apps that we're creating, and as you can see, the peripherals, as well as the STL files, but we're developing this as an open community and hosting the third-party game developers

value.text: Look-up, real-world multiplayer games powered by phone and IoT sensors
value.evidence_span: play mobile games without sitting there staring at this tiny little screen

causal_links.evidence_span: completely interactive gaming anywhere in the world
leverages all of the Internet of Things

notes: Run2 merges thesis into the product identity premise and keeps open-source with cloud as one platform condition. Kickstarter excluded.
